[EN] Hm, it's going to take a while to teach that one.
[ES] Mm, va a tomar un tiempo enseñarle a ese.

[EN] He has potential, but no skill.
[ES] Tiene potencial, pero no habilidad.

[EN] Look how slow he is at drawing his sword.
[ES] Mira qué lento es para desenvainar su espada.

[EN] I'll give him the best training I can,
[ES] Le daré el mejor entrenamiento que pueda,

[EN] until he grows stronger than I am.
[ES] hasta que se vuelva más fuerte que yo.
